notes_for_editor: Only listing evidence: a Forest Lookouts page with the name and county, and a Florida fire-tower list entry (29.93306, -83.58806, Taylor). Record coordinates are within about 30 m of the list. No build date, design, staffing, status, access or photo was found. The 1932 statewide count (source 4) is background only and does not name this tower. Do not confuse with the Huxford in Escambia County, Alabama (easternuslookouts huxford.html). Budget: 2 web searches, about 6 page reads.
